fields.body_md:
## About this programme

The **Master of Global Economy and Strategy (MGES)** is the master's degree of the International Trade, Finance and Management programme. The programme is at Yonsei's Graduate School of International Studies. It trains students in international trade, finance and management. The degree title can change with your entering year.

Yonsei lists English as the language of instruction for Global Studies at GSIS.

## Fees

Tuition is **KRW 7,924,000** a semester for students outside the quota, as of Spring 2026 (**₹5.50 lakh**). The first semester adds a **KRW 1,195,000** entrance fee. Students within the quota pay KRW 7,545,000. Fees can change without notice.

Rupee amounts use **₹0.0694 per Korean won**. We built it from the RBI rate and the Bank of Korea closing rate for 27 November 2026. Your bank's rate will differ.

## Degree rules

- 48 credits, or 42 credits plus a master's thesis.
- A GPA of at least 3.00.
- Finish within 8 semesters.
- Choose one field and take four courses in it.

## Dates

Spring applications run from early September to early November. Fall applications run from early March to early May. Spring 2027 applications ran from 21 September to 2 October 2026. The Fall 2027 dates are not yet published.

## Scholarships

The Incoming Student Award can cover up to 100% of tuition with no application. See the [Yonsei page](/study-abroad/universities/yonsei-university) for the full list.

## Sources

Official pages, checked on 28 November 2026: [GSIS at a Glance](https://graduate.yonsei.ac.kr/gsis/intro/status.do), [GSIS international student admission](https://graduate.yonsei.ac.kr/gsis/admissions/international.do), [GSIS master's degree requirements](https://graduate.yonsei.ac.kr/gsis/education/master_degree.do), [GSIS International Trade, Finance and Management](https://graduate.yonsei.ac.kr/gsis/education/master_degree03.do), [GSIS scholarships](https://graduate.yonsei.ac.kr/gsis/academics/scholarships.do), [RBI exchange rates](https://www.rbi.org.in/) and the [Bank of Korea ECOS statistics](https://ecos.bok.or.kr).
